title: fix: keep tooltips on screen and readable by screen readers
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Tooltips now use their measured size to center beside their trigger, stay within viewport edges, and open above the trigger when there is not enough room below. They remain open while the pointer moves onto the tooltip; Escape, outside taps, and scrolling still dismiss them. Tooltip descriptions are attached to the focusable control, including Enter’s Open WebUI model link, so screen readers can read them. Bumped @pollinations/ui from 0.1.0-alpha.16 to 0.1.0-alpha.17.
